name: IEntityRepository
summary: Multi-device storage abstraction: define IEntityRepository, extract FileSystemRepository from World, make storage methods async for mobile/browser compatibility

rawActions.name: IEntityRepository interface
rawActions.summary: Define IEntityRepository in src/entity.ts: insertOne, findOne (primitive), findMany (AsyncGenerator over keys, realizes via findOne), delete, saveWorld, loadWorld, sync
rawActions.statusNote: Ready for review: IEntityRepository defined in src/world.ts with insertOne, findOne, findMany, delete, saveWorld, loadWorld methods

rawActions.name: FileRepository
rawActions.summary: Extract fs logic from World into FileRepository implementing IEntityRepository
rawActions.statusNote: FileRepository complete with async API matching MongoDB

rawActions.name: LazyNamespace
rawActions.summary: FuzzyNamespace stores (id, EntityClass) stubs; realizes full entity via repository.findOne() on first access; populateNamespace streams keys via findMany AsyncGenerator

rawActions.name: Entity updateId
rawActions.summary: Add updateId timestamp to Forma so findMany can filter by modification time (enables delta-sync across all IEntityRepository implementations)

rawActions.name: World.insertOne() async
rawActions.summary: Change World.insertOne(EntityClass, cfg) from sync to async: create instance, addToNamespace, then await repository.insertOne(EntityClass, instance) to persist. Return the instance. Update signature to return Promise<T>.

rawActions.name: World.findOne() async
rawActions.summary: Change World.loadEntity(EntityClass, id) from sync to async. Keep same logic but await repository.findOne(EntityClass, {id}). Return Promise<T|null>.

rawActions.name: World.findMany() async
rawActions.summary: Replace World entity iteration (currently uses entityList directory scan) to use repository.findMany(EntityClass, {}). Must become async generator compatible in tests.

rawActions.name: World.delete() async
rawActions.summary: Change World.delete(entityType, id) from sync to async. Call await repository.delete(entityType, id). Update #saveEntity handler to propagate async.

rawActions.name: World.saveWorld() async
rawActions.summary: Change World.save() from sync to async. Delegate to await repository.saveWorld(). Return Promise<void>.

rawActions.name: World.loadWorld() async
rawActions.summary: Change World constructor to be async-compatible. Load world data via await repository.loadWorld() during init. May need factory method instead of direct constructor.

rawReferences.name: FileRepository
rawReferences.summary: implementation and test files in src, test

rawReferences.name: saveWorld/loadWorld naming
rawReferences.summary: World is root entity; saveWorld/loadWorld on IEntityRepository persist/load the root. Resolved: these are correct names for the interface methods, not aliases for save()

rawReferences.name: sync on interface
rawReferences.summary: sync() removed from IEntityRepository: it decomposes into loadWorld() + findMany(). Event-driven change notification is a separate concern (event bus), not a repo method. Resolved: drop sync from interface.

rawReferences.name: findMany return type
rawReferences.summary: findMany<T extends EntityConstructor>(EntityClass: T, filter: object): AsyncGenerator<ReturnType<T['fromJson']>>. Same MongoDB-style filter as findOne. FileRepository iterates matching files; MongoDB uses native query cursor. Resolved.

rawReferences.name: findOne primitive
rawReferences.summary: findOne<T extends EntityConstructor>(EntityClass: T, filter: object): ReturnType<T['fromJson']>|null. MongoDB-style filter e.g. {id:'abc123'}. FileRepository scans files and matches fields; MongoDB uses native query. Resolved.

rawReferences.name: insertOne generic constraint
rawReferences.summary: insertOne<T extends EntityConstructor>(EntityClass: T, cfg: object): ReturnType<T['fromJson']>. World.insertOne already has this signature — preserve it on IEntityRepository unchanged. Resolved.
